# N6 IIRR: complete geometry and exact cap tables

These fixed tables are part of the proof in N6_IIRR.md. All determinants
refer to the ten actual points and the fixed rational box stated there.
The binary tree is complete; no coordinate sampling or external discovery
file is a premise. The companion N6_IIRR_AREA_CHAINS.md prints every
remaining exact area contradiction.

## Nonnegative box-corner differences

For a box cap with indices i0<...<ik, corner m chooses the upper endpoint
of index ij exactly when bit j of m is one. Every entry below is the cap
minus the signed determinant at that corner. All entries are nonnegative.
Multiaffinity therefore proves the cap throughout the entire closed box.
